【BTC/USD Market Outlook】
BTCUSD rose 6.86%, surging to $86,719. Strong upward momentum continues, helped by $433 million flowing into Bitcoin ETFs on Friday. The RSI has reached the overbought level of 74.65, and the Bollinger Bands are widening, indicating rising upside volatility. The key levels to watch are support at $77,044 and resistance near $90,000.

📊 Today's USDJPY market outlook by analyst Nick
🎯 Nick's key points: USDJPY continues to test the upside following last week's FOMC and BOJ meetings. While the view that the current US-Japan interest rate gap will persist supports it, wariness of currency intervention near 158 yen is capping the upside. ↓

USDJPY continues to test the upside, and the 10-day moving average has also turned upward. As the market tests whether the BOJ and the Fed can stop this trend, it seems good to watch for buying opportunities on dips.

Today's focus is the US S&P Global Manufacturing PMI.
📈 US PMI above forecast → bullish for USDJPY
📉 US PMI below forecast → bearish for USDJPY

Support: 156.00, 155.00, 153.00

📊 Today's USDJPY market outlook by analyst Nick
🎯 Nick's key points: Ahead of tonight's US jobs report, USDJPY is testing the upside. WTI crude oil prices have risen again, and expectations of an additional US rate hike have strengthened. ↓

USDJPY has risen above the 10-day moving average again, and the uptrend appears to have resumed. The next big move will likely depend on tonight's US jobs report.

Today's focus is the US jobs report.

📉 US jobs report below forecast → downward pressure on USDJPY

【XAU/USD Market Outlook】
Gold fell to $4,138.95, weighed down by rising US Treasury yields. US nonfarm payrolls (NFP) rose by only 29,000 against the expected 89,000, but there was no major change in the Fed's policy rate outlook. Bond market trends and the next FOMC meeting are in focus for gauging the future direction. The RSI is 38.36, showing bearishness, but has not yet reached oversold levels. Support is at $4,100 and resistance is at $4,300.

【EUR/JPY Market Outlook】
EUR/JPY fell 0.21% to 177.209 amid European political uncertainty. It is trading below its moving averages, and the bearish trend continues. Support is at 176 yen and resistance is at 180 yen. The RSI is 29.63, at an oversold level, and trading near the lower Bollinger Band also suggests the decline may have gone too far. Attention will now turn to a speech by BOJ Governor Ueda.

📊 Today's USDJPY market outlook by analyst Nick
🎯 Nick's key points: This week USDJPY is edging up while calm trading continues. It is supported by WTI crude oil prices staying high and Fed officials indicating the possibility of additional rate hikes. ↓

While US inflation concerns support USDJPY, wariness of currency intervention caps the upside when it rises, leaving buyers and sellers balanced. A slow test of the upside is expected.

Today's focus is the FOMC minutes.
📈 Concern about inflation and a stance supporting additional rate hikes → factor pushing USDJPY up
📉 A stance opposing additional rate hikes → factor pushing USDJPY down

Resistance: 158.50, 159.00, 160.00
Support: 157.00, 156.00, 155.00

【XAU/USD Market Outlook】
Gold prices rebounded from the monthly low and rose to $4,194.24. News about Trump's supply of Russian diesel fuel eased fuel shortage concerns and provided support.
However, it is still down 20% since late February, against the backdrop of central banks' aggressive stance on rate hikes. The RSI is 45.64, with key support at $4,112 and resistance at $4,356. The next focus is the US Consumer Price Index (CPI) to be released on Wednesday.

【GBP/JPY Market Outlook】
GBPJPY is trading at 209.495. Yen weakness continues against the backdrop of concerns over expanding global debt, weak household spending, and debate over tax cuts. Prime Minister Takaichi explained the validity of her fiscal policy to restore market confidence. The RSI is 47.20, in the neutral zone. Support is at 208.83 and resistance is at 210.89.

Good morning ☀️

Yesterday I switched my iPhone from a 12 to a 17 💃💃💃

It should have been easy to migrate with Quick Start, but LINE's initial settings changed and I was suddenly added by lots of different people 💦

I leave scalp entries without taking profit, and when they're gone I do another scalp entry and leave it. 😨　
Of course it disappears if I don't take profit 🙅‍♀️🙅‍♀️🙅‍♀️

The migration to the iPhone 17 is almost done too 😅 so today I want to grow my money 👏

【Why I withdrew the mysterious amount of 999,995 yen to my bank in overseas FX】

This is the reason I have repeatedly withdrawn odd amounts like 999,995 yen or 999,997 yen from Exness until now.

First, the reason I split each withdrawal to under 1 million yen is as in the quoted post.

Furthermore, the reason I don't standardize on 999,999 yen, the maximum amount under 1 million yen, but deliberately shift the amount by 1 yen or 10 yen at a time is to make it easier to match later on the statement which withdrawal has arrived.

Honestly, I don't know how meaningful such measures are.

Perhaps I'm doing something completely meaningless.

But if it's to protect my own money, I will do thoroughly even what might be useless.

Not just earning, but thinking all the way to protecting the money you've earned.

That is what I think makes a true fat trader.
